title: Metaverse Engine diagnostics v1
rule: A number is never changed and never used again. A changed meaning is a new id (.v2) with a new number.

codes.name: not-in-state
codes.means: Nothing in the realm's state or content has this id. Fix the id, or author the thing.

codes.name: spawn-pending
codes.means: It is in the state, and the world builds it at its next commit. Ask again after a frame.

codes.name: spawn-refused
codes.means: The world had no free slot for it. Remove something or raise the world's capacity.

codes.name: despawned
codes.means: It was in the world and was removed: defeated, opened or deleted. It comes back only by a reset or an edit.

codes.name: not-in-view
codes.means: It stands outside what the camera sees. Move or turn the camera.

codes.name: draw-pending
codes.means: Its draw rows are older than the state. The next frame writes them.

codes.name: draw-dropped
codes.means: The draw list or its store was full, and it was left out. Draw fewer things or raise the limit.

codes.name: draw-hidden
codes.means: The realm or its host hides it now: a mode that doesn't show it, or a host that draws this kind itself.

codes.name: asset-loading
codes.means: Its mesh, texture or pack is still arriving.

codes.name: asset-failed
codes.means: Its asset was fetched and refused, or the fetch failed.

codes.name: collider-missing
codes.means: It should block or be touched, and has no collider.

codes.name: collider-open
codes.means: It has a collider that doesn't block now.

codes.name: system-pending
codes.means: The system that moves it hasn't run since it spawned.

codes.name: system-paused
codes.means: The system that moves it is stopped: a mode, a pause or a budget.

codes.name: budget-hit
codes.means: A budget was reached and work was dropped. The line names the limit and how much was dropped.

codes.name: pack-refused
codes.means: A pack was read and refused.
